note: India incentive seed (design E6.9). NOTHING here is verified. Real-named schemes are qualitative only (params null, landing page of the issuing body, never a deep link, retrieved_on null because nobody retrieved them from the source). Numbers exist ONLY in the demo-synthetic records, which name no real body and exist so the incentive-adjusted capex and payback can be demonstrated. Do not add a rate, cap or deep link to a real-named scheme unless a human records the primary source and sets verified = true.
name_note: Scheme names as commonly referred to; confirm current status (some may be closed or renamed).

records.name: Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) energy-efficiency trading
records.authority: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (Ministry of Power)
records.benefit_description: Designated energy-intensive consumers receive energy-saving targets; savings beyond the target can earn tradeable energy-saving certificates.
records.eligibility_notes: Applies to notified designated consumers above sector thresholds. Confirm whether this plant is a designated consumer and the current cycle.

records.name: Accelerated depreciation for energy-saving and pollution-control equipment (income-tax provision)
records.benefit_description: The income-tax depreciation schedule has provided higher depreciation rates for certain energy-saving and pollution-control equipment.
records.eligibility_notes: Eligible items and rates depend on the current depreciation schedule and the tax regime chosen. Confirm with a tax adviser; no rate is assumed here.

records.name: Energy-efficiency finance line for MSMEs (SIDBI "4E"-type scheme)
records.authority: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
records.benefit_description: Concessional loans for MSME energy-efficiency and cleaner-production investments.
records.eligibility_notes: Terms, rates and eligible equipment change between scheme versions. Confirm the current offer with SIDBI.

records.name: MSME technology-upgrade capital-subsidy schemes (CLCSS and successors; may be closed)
records.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
records.benefit_description: Capital subsidy for MSME technology upgradation under the credit-linked capital-subsidy scheme family.
records.eligibility_notes: The original scheme may be closed or replaced. Confirm whether any successor scheme is open for this sector before relying on it.

records.name: Green Credit Programme (environment ministry)
records.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
records.benefit_description: A market-based mechanism that awards green credits for notified environment-positive activities.
records.eligibility_notes: Rules were notified in October 2023 under the Environment (Protection) Act; notified activities have so far focused on tree plantation. Confirm whether an industrial upgrade qualifies.

records.name: Renewable and energy-efficiency project finance (IREDA-type)
records.benefit_description: Project finance for renewable-energy and energy-efficiency projects.
records.eligibility_notes: Project size thresholds and terms apply. Confirm the current lending policy with IREDA.

records.name: Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) certification support for MSMEs
records.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
records.benefit_description: Certification and handholding support for MSMEs adopting quality and low-environmental-impact practices.
records.eligibility_notes: Support levels depend on the enterprise category and certification level. Confirm on the ZED portal.

records.name: Illustrative MSME capital subsidy (demo values)
records.authority: Illustrative demo, not a real body
records.benefit_description: Invented for the demo: a capital subsidy of 15% of capex, capped at INR 50 lakh.
records.eligibility_notes: Not a real scheme. It exists only to show how an incentive changes capex and payback for a small enterprise.

records.name: Illustrative accelerated deduction for large enterprises (demo values)
records.authority: Illustrative demo, not a real body
records.benefit_description: Invented for the demo: an additional first-year deduction of 40% of capex; the benefit is the tax saved on it at an illustrative 25% tax rate.
records.eligibility_notes: Not a real scheme. It exists only to show how an incentive changes capex and payback for a large enterprise.
